import json,pathlib,re,subprocess,hashlib
report=json.loads(pathlib.Path("/private/tmp/localos-tree-staged-scan-20260921.JWYzSU/redacted.json").read_text())
diff=subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/git","diff","--cached","--binary"],capture_output=True,check=True).stdout
assert hashlib.sha256(diff).hexdigest()=="977964e2c5db8185f984781ffc96ceb1b40dbedf7e778e3e75c0d09fbb8ff6f6"
lines=diff.decode().splitlines()
known=[
"Original scan, base metadata, statuses and historical verdict preserved. No URI/key validity, expiry, revocation or access-scope proof. Exact22 membership remains unproven despite established graph-vs-fragment counter semantics. Roots-only digest check was8/25; complete frozen path history proves25/25. Initial mapping/context stdout truncation and nonexistent-rg failure are retained, not passes. No Docker context/image/layer verification, application imports, DB, provider request, deletion, history rewrite, production, push or deploy. Nine foreign paths and unsafe-reset INCONCLUSIVE effects persist. Aggregate/restore authority pending; available6.06GiB below10GiB image floor. OverallFAIL unchanged.",
"31non-secret source digests/fixtures/identifiers,10Google Docs image-access URI"
]
out=[]
for i,f in enumerate(report,1):
 assert f["Secret"]=="REDACTED"
 line=lines[f["StartLine"]-1]; parts=f["Match"].split("REDACTED")
 vals=set(m.group(1) for m in re.finditer(re.escape(parts[0])+r"(.+?)"+re.escape(parts[1]),line)); assert len(vals)==1
 v=next(iter(vals))
 out.append({"id":i,"matched_length":len(v),"candidate_is_substring_of_fixed_authored_prose":[j+1 for j,s in enumerate(known) if v in s],"whole_known_paragraph_in_diff_line":[j+1 for j,s in enumerate(known) if s in line],"wordlike":bool(re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_/.-]+",v)),"whitespace":bool(re.search(r"\s",v))})
print(json.dumps({"rows":out,"values_withheld":True},indent=2))
